{{External|rs}} {{Otheruses|the standard baby reds|the baby reds that can be built in [[player-owned house]]s|Baby red dragon (Construction)}} {{HasTask|Red dragons}} {{Infobox Monster |version1 = 1 |version2 = 2 |version3 = 3 |name = Baby red dragon |image1 = [[File:Baby red dragon (1).png|250px]] |image2 = [[File:Baby red dragon (2).png|250px]] |image3 = [[File:Baby red dragon (3).png|250px]] |release = [[17 January]] [[2005]] |update = Karamja Dungeon |members = Yes |combat = 48 |size = 2 |examine = Young but still dangerous. |attributes = dragon |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 5 |aggressive = Yes |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Slash]] |attack speed = 4 |respawn = 30 |slayxp = 50 |cat = Red Dragons |assignedby = konar,nieve,duradel |hitpoints = 50 |att = 40 |str = 40 |def = 40 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 50 |dcrush = 50 |dmagic = 40 |dlight = 30 |dstandard = 30 |dheavy = 10 |elementalweaknesstype = Water |elementalweaknesspercent = 50 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |immunecannon = No |immunethrall = No |id1 = 244 |id2 = 245 |id3 = 246 }} '''Baby red dragons''' are located in the [[Brimhaven Dungeon]], [[Forthos Dungeon]], the [[Dragon Nest]], and in the basement of the [[Myths' Guild]]. They have the same [[combat level]] as the [[baby blue dragon]]s that inhabit the [[Taverley Dungeon]]. Players seeking [[baby dragon bones]] before the completion of [[Dragon Slayer II]] often choose to fight their blue counterparts, as in both the [[Forthos Dungeon]] and [[Brimhaven Dungeon]], there is a risk of being attacked by adult [[red dragon]]s while using melee. Additionally, the [[Brimhaven Dungeon]] requires an [[axe]] and {{coins|875}} to enter, and has [[wild dog]]s that can attack even when [[safespot]]ting with [[Ranged]] or [[Magic]]. Like all chromatic dragons, baby red dragons are weak to ranged, magic, and stab attacks. They do not attack with [[dragonfire]]. ==Locations== {{LocTableHead}} {{LocLine |name = Baby red dragon |location = [[Brimhaven Dungeon]] |levels = 48 |members = Yes |mapID = 46 |plane = 0 |x:2696,y:9501|x:2698,y:9524|x:2708,y:9500|x:2708,y:9526|x:2711,y:9516|x:2714,y:9505|x:2721,y:9511|x:2721,y:9530|x:2730,y:9512|x:2701,y:9548|x:2709,y:9545|x:2720,y:9536 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = Karamja }} {{LocLine |name = Baby red dragon |location = [[Corsair Cove Dungeon]]/[[Myths' Guild|Myths' Guild (basement)]]Requires completion of [[Dragon Slayer II]] |levels = 48 |members = Yes |mapID = -1 |plane = 1 |x:1889,y:8995|x:1891,y:8998 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = Kandarin }} {{LocLine |name = Baby red dragon |location = [[Forthos Dungeon]] |levels = 48 |members = Yes |mapID = 32 |plane = 0 |x:1811,y:9937|x:1818,y:9931|x:1827,y:9930|x:1827,y:9937|x:1828,y:9928 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = Kourend }} {{LocLine |name=Baby red dragon |location=[[Dragon Nest]] |levels=48 |members=Yes |mapID= -1 |plane = 0 |x:1254,y:9493|x:1257,y:9491 |spawns=2 |leagueRegion = Varlamore }} {{LocTableBottom}} ==Drops== ===100%=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Babydragon bones|quantity=1|rarity=Always}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ===Tertiary=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Tattered moon page|quantity=1|rarity=1/25|raritynotes={{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Husky|url=https://twitter.com/JagexHusky/status/1156844944369377286|date=1 August 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/101821|archivedate=1 August 2019|quote=For those interested, here are the drop-rates for the unique items within the Forthos Dungeon.[https://pbs.twimg.com/media/EA3wV4DW4AAVtos?format=jpg&name=small]|name=Forthos Dungeon Droprates}}Tattered pages and grubby keys are only dropped by those found in the [[Forthos Dungeon]].The drop rate to receive any tattered page is 1/25.
